subject.title: Stuck-session liveness monitor misclassifies healthy processing runs as stale during event-loop stalls

question: Should this be queued as a source-level diagnostic fix now, or wait for focused live/current-main proof of the event-loop-stall abort chain?
rationale: Current source shows the fallthrough, but the report itself marks the causal abort chain as likely and changing processing-state recovery can affect legitimate stuck-session cleanup.

options.title: Request focused proof first
options.body: Keep this open and ask for a live/log or focused current-main test proving processing/no-active-work should not enter recoverable stale state before automation changes recovery behavior.

options.title: Queue narrow repair now
options.body: Allow a narrow repair that classifies processing/no-active-work as non-recoverable or observe-only and proves idle stale recovery still works.

options.title: Fold into recovery policy work
options.body: Treat this as part of broader stuck-session recovery policy if maintainers want a larger ladder or threshold decision instead of a small classification fix.

recommendation.title: Request focused proof first
recommendation.body: Keep this open and ask for a live/log or focused current-main test proving processing/no-active-work should not enter recoverable stale state before automation changes recovery behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent diagnostic recovery and telemetry work makes this the best available routing candidate for the immediate classification contract decision.
